'''Sora Bulq''' was a [[Weequay]] [[Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order]]. Bulq trained [[Galdos Stouff]] as their [[padawan]]. After [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] discovered that the Separatists had been building up their own droid army on [[Geonosis]], Bulq and Stouff, along with 212 other readily available Jedi were dispatched to the [[desert]] [[planet]], and subsequently took part in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]].

Bulq was later present in a meeting in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] in which the dastardly cyborg [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|leader]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]], [[Grievous]], demonstrated his wrath to the Jedi, by torturing their fellow Jedi, [[Eeth Koth]], live through the use of a hologram for them to see. After the Jedi Temple hangar was bombed, Bulq attended the funeral for those that had lost their lives.


==Biography==
===The Battle of Geonosis===
Sora Bulq was a member of the [[Jedi Order]]<ref name="Abyss">''[[Mace Windu: The Glass Abyss]]''</ref> who trained [[Galdos Stouff]] as their [[Padawan]].<ref name="CL" /> Bulq also developed a friendship with fellow Jedi [[Mace Windu]] that was longstanding<ref name="Abyss" /> by [[32 BBY]].<ref name="GlassDate">The events of ''[[Mace Windu: The Glass Abyss]]'' take place the [[Standard week|week]] after the [[funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[32 BBY]].</ref> Together, Bulq and Windu created the [[Form VII|Vaapad]] [[lightsaber combat]] form.<ref name="Abyss" /> By [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> tensions between the [[Galactic Republic]] and a rising faction known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] were growing at an alarming rate. After [[senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]] narrowly survived multiple assassination attempts, it was discovered that the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] was behind it. Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] subsequently followed the [[Mandalorian]] to the barren world of [[Geonosis]], discovering that the Separatists had been developing their own [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]], and contacted the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] about his findings. Moments after sending a hologram, the Jedi was discovered and captured. [[Mace Windu]] then made the decision to assemble a [[Jedi assault team]],<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> made up of the 212 available Jedi, to crush the droid army the Separatists had been creating,<ref name="Inquisitor">''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]''</ref> and to rescue Obi Wan.<ref name="Attack of the Clones" />

[[File:JediCircle.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Bulq amongst the survivors in the Petranaki arena.]]
Sora Bulq, joined by Stouff, was one of the many Jedi sent out to Geonosis, as part of the Jedi assault team.<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> During the battle, both Bulq and Stouff managed to defeat a dozen of encircling [[Geonosian]] guards.<ref name="CL" /> After fighting valiantly against the newfound [[Separatist Droid Army]] for the majority of the battle, Sora Bulq, along with the other surviving Jedi eventually found themselves totally outnumbered by their mechanical foes, leaving them with no choice, but to form a defensive circle. Just as it seemed that all hope was lost, and that the Jedi had lost the battle, multiple [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|republic gunships]] stormed the arena, with a brand new army of clone soldiers to back the Jedi. The gunships then landed, allowing for Sora Bulq and the other survivors to escape the arena.<ref name="Attack of the Clones" />

===A message from Grievous===
[[File:Bulqgrievous.png|thumb|right|250px|Bulq and other Jedi watched Grievous's transmission.]]
One year later, in [[21 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> a meeting was called at the [[Jedi Temple communication center]] of which many Jedi, including Sora Bulq, attended. The [[Weequay]] Jedi was already present when the leader of the Separatist Droid Army, [[General]] [[Grievous]], appeared on the [[holoprojector]] with a daunting message for the Jedi, informing them that he had captured the [[Jedi High Council]] member [[Eeth Koth]]. He taunted them as he expressed his hatred of their politics and their Republic, and that he only lived to see them die. Sora Bulq and the other Jedi watched in horror as Grievous threw Jedi Master Eeth Koth to the ground and one of his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard|MagnaGuards]] began torturing him with its [[electrostaff]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>

===The Jedi Temple Bombing===
[[File:TempleBombingFuneral.png|thumb|left|250px|Sora Bulq attended the funeral for the Jedi that had died in the Jedi Temple Hangar bombing.]]
In the final year of the Clone Wars, [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Sora Bulq was present in the Jedi Temple at the time of a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombing incident]], in which the Jedi Temple hanger had exploded, causing the death of a dozen people consisting of several clones, numerous workers and six Jedi. During the investigation led by [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]], Sora Bulq was walking past as Anakin entered the Jedi Temple Detention Center in order to question their prime suspect, [[Letta Turmond]].<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref> Sora Bulq later attended the [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims|funeral]] of the six Jedi that had been killed in the explosion, silently and solemnly standing next to his Jedi comrades, listening to Jedi Master [[Yoda]]'s eulogy for the fallen.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
As a typical Weequay, Sora Bulq had black [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and dark skin. They revered their position as a Jedi Master, and attended war room meetings they were needed in.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> They were also shown to be respectful, attending the funeral for those who had lost their lives in a bombing attack at the Jedi Temple and they remained in the temple for most of the Clone Wars.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" />

==Powers and abilities==
Sora Bulq was a capable warrior, after fighting valiantly against the Separatist droid army which considerably outnumbered the Jedi. The Weequay Jedi managed to fight their way through the entirety of the battle and was one of the few survivors.<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> They developed the [[Form VII#Form VII: Vaapad|Vaapad]] offshoot of [[Form VII]] [[lightsaber combat]] alongside their friend, Mace Windu.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Equipment==
Sora Bulq used a blue [[lightsaber]] and wore [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]]<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> along with gauntlets.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SoraBulqCharacterModel.jpg|thumb|right|230px|The character model for Sora Bulq used throughout the Clone Wars television series.]]
Sora Bulq first appeared as a background character in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars:'' Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. Bulq's background story was heavily expanded upon in the now [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, with his character being the focus of several stories, in which he fell to the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]], becoming one of [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] top subordinates. Sora Bulq later appeared as an unnamed background character in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|season two]] episode "[[Grievous Intrigue]]." The Weequay Jedi seen in the episode was not confirmed to be Bulq, until the episode guide for the episode was released, where it was revealed that the character model had been labelled with the name Sora Bulq.<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/grievous-intrigue-episode-guide|text="Grievous Intrigue" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref>
